quickCustomInstructions.title: Quick Guide: How to Save Custom Presets on Any Camera
quickCustomInstructions.Panasonic: Set Mode Dial to P/A/S/M → Adjust Photo Style, WB Shift, and Highlight/Shadow → Menu → [Custom Wrench] → [Cust. Set Mem.] → Select C1, C2, or C3.
quickCustomInstructions.Olympus_OM: Adjust Picture Mode & White Balance → Menu → Reset / Custom Modes → Assign to Custom Mode (C1–C4) → Turn Mode Dial to C1/C2.
quickCustomInstructions.Fujifilm: Menu → Edit/Save Custom Setting → Choose C1–C7 → Configure Film Simulation, Grain, Tone Curve, & WB Shift → Save.
quickCustomInstructions.Sony: Set Exposure Mode → Menu → Shooting → Memory / [MR Camera Set] → Save to Memory Slot 1, 2, or 3.
quickCustomInstructions.Canon: Dial in Picture Style & WB → Menu → Setup Menu (Wrench) → [Custom Shooting Mode (C1-C3)] → Register Settings.
quickCustomInstructions.Nikon: Configure Picture Control & WB → Menu → Setup Menu → Save User Settings → Choose U1, U2, or U3.
